name: 63116 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63116 (Saint Louis) has 120 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63116 (Saint Louis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63116 (Saint Louis) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 56 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
